✦ THE FROG TECHNIQUE

Tap hands alternately to cruise.
Hold either rear leg, then release.

A longer hold makes a bigger leap and clears river junk. The leg visibly coils while charging.

NO DOWNLOADS. NO SIGN-UP. JUST SUSPICIOUS FROG ATHLETICS.

FROG SWIM SCHOOL / 20 SECONDS

Pull. Charge. Leap.

Front hands swim: alternate left and right taps to build steady speed.

Rear legs leap: hold J or K—or hold either rear-leg button—to coil that leg. Release it for a powerful kick and jump. Longer holds travel farther and clear obstacles.

The current pushes sideways. Left and right hand pulls gently correct your line.
